title: Security Deposit Account Mid-Lease Reduction Review Terms by Program
content:
Some deposit programs of the Security Deposit Account are reviewed during the lease for a reduction of the deposit. This schedule shows, for every program, whether it is reviewed, after how many full months since move-in, how many late fee billing periods the review window tolerates, and which program the account moves to after a successful review.

| Program | Reviewed for a reduction | Full months since move-in | Late fee billing periods tolerated in the window | Program after a successful review |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan | no | 0 | 0 | not applicable |
| Reduced Deposit Plan | no | 0 | 0 | not applicable |
| Standard Deposit Plan | no | 0 | 0 | not applicable |
| Premier Residence Deposit Plan | no | 0 | 0 | not applicable |
| Conditional Approval Deposit Plan | yes | 12 | 0 | Standard Deposit Plan |
| Enhanced Deposit Plan | yes | 12 | 0 | Conditional Approval Deposit Plan |

### Notes to the schedule

- Only the Conditional Approval Deposit Plan and the Enhanced Deposit Plan are reviewed. The first four programs show 0 and "not applicable" because no review applies to them.
- A reviewed program tolerates 0 late fee billing periods in its 12-month window.
- A successful review moves each reviewed program one step: from the Enhanced Deposit Plan to the Conditional Approval Deposit Plan, and from the Conditional Approval Deposit Plan to the Standard Deposit Plan.
